phaseA.question: fixed conditional HP-input transforms on Tail-consumed wins; teacher-forced descriptive only

phaseB.featureConstruction: only frozen ordinary pDeath, reserve-proxy pWin, and their fixed difference; outcomes are labels only
phaseB.interpretation: five LOSS_CONSUMED rows are too few to qualify rescue prediction
phaseB.sampleSizeRationale: reach about five observed losses per 5-fold holdout set; this is a minimum reassessment target, not a qualification guarantee

phaseC.samplerBoundary: ordinary conditional heads only after WIN; Tail class controls active/spent state; losses terminate; Mark/Fairy exact boundaries fall back

claimBoundary: descriptive development diagnostic only; no training artifact, runtime integration, or production qualification
